dek: PawDings is a startup app for iPhone, Android and the web that holds dog owners to being more active with their dogs. It is location-aware, sends one thoughtful, weather-aware idea a day, and tracks how active you actually are through GPS, check-ins and fully customizable notifications and reminders.
short: An app I created for iOS, Android and the web that keeps dog owners active: one weather- and location-aware idea a day, GPS arrival checks and fully customizable reminders, on Expo with a typed OpenAPI backend.

facts.label: Platforms
facts.value: iOS, Android and web from one codebase

items.name: expo-location
items.note: opt-in, with arrival checks once an activity starts

items.name: expo-notifications
items.note: daily or weekly, at a chosen time

highlights.title: One nudge, not a feed
highlights.text: A single daily recommendation ranked by the pet's energy and size, the weather, distance and opening hours, with a few alternatives.

highlights.title: Activity you can see
highlights.text: Starting an idea arms an on-device arrival check, so a walk counts as a walk. Reminders, their days and their times are all the owner's to set.

highlights.title: Privacy by restraint
highlights.text: Location is asked for only when it is needed, stored coarse for learning, and never sold. Sponsored places are always labelled and never outrank safety or fit.

highlights.title: Built to swap the backend
highlights.text: The UI talks to a typed repository interface: sample data today, the HTTP API tomorrow, with no screen rewritten.
